definition: Operational canonical study-level input for the TcCO2-PaCO2 agreement model
description: CSV source used for canonical promotion package workflows and browser staging
source_or_origin: Conway Thorax evidence synthesis and Figshare source archive
derivation_or_transformation: Curated from source study summaries into repository schema
validation_rules: must be nonempty and satisfy validate_conway_studies_df and semantic parity with XLSX within 1e-12
notes: Requested subgroup analyses must also be nonempty; canonical executable promotion source

definition: Human-editable review mirror of the canonical Conway CSV
description: Spreadsheet form for review and study additions
derivation_or_transformation: Same rows and values as canonical CSV
validation_rules: must satisfy validate_conway_studies_df after read_excel and semantic parity with CSV within 1e-12
notes: Not a direct canonical promotion source

definition: Blank or template workbook for adding Conway-compatible studies
derivation_or_transformation: Structured to match Conway study schema
validation_rules: must contain required Conway schema columns
notes: Use docs/ADDING_STUDIES.md before editing

definition: Public count fallback used when exporting Conway RData to canonical study tables
description: Study-level counts for paired measurements and participants
derivation_or_transformation: Used by scripts/export_conway_rdata.py as fallback
validation_rules: must include study_id n_pairs n_participants c and satisfy the canonical count and c rules
notes: Missing or blank identifiers and noninteger observed counts fail even with --no-strict or --allow-missing-counts

definition: Public normalized PaCO2 prior weights for browser deployment
description: Weight-only 1 mmHg bins by group without exact count columns
units: mmHg for paco2_bin; probability weight for weight
allowed_values: group values used by app; paco2_bin finite and positive; weight nonnegative
source_or_origin: Restricted local PaCO2 distribution transformed for public deployment
derivation_or_transformation: Binned to 1 mmHg and normalized to weights; exact counts omitted
validation_rules: paco2_bin supports must be finite and positive with no hard upper cutoff; weights must be nonnegative and sum approximately 1 within group
notes: Does not expose exact count-bearing prior bins

definition: Unique Conway study/cohort identifier
description: Primary key in Conway study input table
derivation_or_transformation: Curated from source study labels
validation_rules: must be non-empty and unique after surrounding whitespace is stripped
notes: Required by validate_conway_studies_df

definition: Study-level mean difference defined as PaCO2 - TcCO2
description: Input to meta-analysis and agreement model
derivation_or_transformation: Curated from Conway evidence synthesis/source tables
validation_rules: must be finite
notes: Sign convention follows docs/SPEC.md

definition: Study-level standard deviation of PaCO2 - TcCO2 differences
missing_values: column may be omitted if s2 is present; values in a supplied column cannot be blank
derivation_or_transformation: Curated or derived from source variance
validation_rules: must be finite and positive; if s2 is supplied then sd squared must agree at rtol 1e-10 and atol 1e-12
notes: Omit a discordant redundant field rather than forcing agreement

definition: Study-level variance of PaCO2 - TcCO2 differences
missing_values: column may be omitted if sd is present; values in a supplied column cannot be blank
derivation_or_transformation: Usually sd squared or source variance
validation_rules: must be finite and positive; if sd is supplied then s2 must agree with sd squared at rtol 1e-10 and atol 1e-12
notes: Omit a discordant redundant field rather than forcing agreement

definition: Number of paired PaCO2/TcCO2 measurements contributing to a study row
description: Used for meta-analysis weights and repeated-measure handling
derivation_or_transformation: Curated from source counts
validation_rules: must be finite and integer-valued and at least n_participants
notes: May exceed participants when repeated measures exist

definition: Number of participants contributing paired measurements
description: Used with n_pairs to derive repeated-measure count c
derivation_or_transformation: Curated from source counts
validation_rules: must be finite and integer-valued and greater than 1
notes: Must not exceed n_pairs

definition: Average paired measurements per participant
missing_values: column may be omitted; values in a supplied column cannot be blank
derivation_or_transformation: Usually n_pairs / n_participants
validation_rules: if supplied must be finite and at least 1 and match n_pairs / n_participants at rtol 1e-10 and atol 1e-12
notes: Omit the column when package code should derive the exact ratio

definition: Indicator that study row belongs to ICU subgroup
derivation_or_transformation: Curated subgroup classification
validation_rules: must be boolean-like and non-missing
notes: May overlap is_arf or is_lft; Conway flags are not mutually exclusive

definition: Indicator that study row belongs to acute respiratory failure subgroup
derivation_or_transformation: Curated subgroup classification
validation_rules: must be boolean-like and non-missing
notes: May overlap is_icu or is_lft; Conway flags are not mutually exclusive

definition: Indicator that study row belongs to ambulatory/PFT subgroup
derivation_or_transformation: Curated subgroup classification
validation_rules: must be boolean-like and non-missing
notes: May overlap is_icu or is_arf; Conway flags are not mutually exclusive

definition: Clinical setting group for PaCO2 prior bins
value_labels: all = overall | pft = ambulatory/PFT | ed_inp = ED/inpatient | icu = ICU
derivation_or_transformation: Whitespace stripped and lowercased
validation_rules: normalized labels must collectively contain exactly pft ed_inp icu and all with no missing or extra groups
notes: Exact counts intentionally omitted

definition: Public-prior support value or inclusive lower edge for conditional curves
description: Used as prior support or the lower edge of a half-open conditional display bin
allowed_values: positive finite for prior support; finite for conditional lower edge
derivation_or_transformation: Binned from restricted local PaCO2 distribution
validation_rules: prior supports must be finite and positive with no hard upper cutoff; conditional lower edges must be finite
notes: Conditional truth is computed from unbinned values; public prior bins omit exact counts

definition: Exclusive upper edge paired with the conditional output paco2_bin lower edge
description: Defines an explicit half-open display interval
derivation_or_transformation: Derived as paco2_bin plus bin width
validation_rules: must be finite and greater than paco2_bin
notes: Truth and test probability are computed from unbinned values before aggregation

definition: Normalized public prior weight for a group and PaCO2 bin
derivation_or_transformation: Exact counts converted to normalized weights
validation_rules: must be nonnegative and group sums should be approximately 1
notes: No count column should be added publicly

definition: Optional browser upload replacing default Conway study table
description: CSV or XLSX supplied by user in browser
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed client-side and passed to Pyodide worker
validation_rules: must satisfy Conway study schema
notes: Not transmitted to backend

definition: Optional browser upload replacing default public PaCO2 prior
description: CSV or XLSX supplied by user in browser
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed client-side and passed to Pyodide worker
validation_rules: paco2_bin supports finite and positive; weights nonnegative; required columns present
notes: Not transmitted to backend

definition: Observed transcutaneous CO2 value entered in the app
description: Main scalar input for posterior inference
derivation_or_transformation: Passed to Python model in Pyodide
validation_rules: must be numeric and nonnegative
notes: Research-only input; not persisted

definition: PaCO2 threshold used for posterior mass and TcCO2 classification
derivation_or_transformation: Passed to Python model in Pyodide
validation_rules: must be finite and strictly positive
notes: Default 45 mmHg

definition: Retained arterial carbon dioxide value
description: Input to distribution simulation conditional and two-stage calculations
missing_values: genuine missing source rows dropped before retained-row validation
source_or_origin: Restricted source distribution or caller input
derivation_or_transformation: Source rows retained after genuine missing values are excluded
validation_rules: must be finite and strictly positive with no hard upper cutoff
notes: Malformed infinite zero or negative retained values fail closed

definition: Mutually exclusive record-level subgroup label
description: Used when a caller supplies already prepared PaCO2 rows
value_labels: pft = ambulatory/PFT | ed_inp = ED/inpatient | icu = ICU
derivation_or_transformation: Whitespace stripped and lowercased after genuinely missing PaCO2 rows are dropped
validation_rules: each retained label must be nonmissing and one of pft ed_inp or icu
notes: all is reserved for pooled priors and is invalid as a record label

definition: Raw indicator for ambulatory or lung-function-test records

definition: Raw indicator for emergency-department records

definition: Raw indicator for inpatient records

definition: Raw indicator for critical-care timing

definition: Lower TcCO2 boundary of the two-stage reflex zone

definition: Upper TcCO2 boundary of the two-stage reflex zone
